frames.narration: The page wants the best price. It hands the question to the scatterer.
The scatterer asks all five vendors at the same moment, with a 300 ms deadline.
E fails at 60 ms. B answers at 80 ms, A at 120 ms, D at 200 ms. The gatherer keeps three prices.
Vendor C would answer at 450 ms with the cheapest price, but the deadline passes first.
At 300 ms the gatherer stops waiting and merges what it has: the lowest of three prices.
The page shows the best price after 300 ms, not after the 910 ms that asking one by one would take, and says it used 3 of 5 answers.
